Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Kemintiri becomes a Liaison. Later she merges. I just want to make sure that

a) she will lose the 4 votes when she gains the 3
b) the Liaison title will then become available for another vampire.

Thanks,

Orpheus

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:


Hi my Consilieri! :D

a) Once Merged, she gains a new title ("3 votes"). So she loses the
Liaison one.
b) Since the Liaison title is lost, it is available for a new vampire
for as long as Rise of the Nephtali is still in play. In fact, one
could argue that it was always available, since any vampire could try
to get it - at most, a 10-cap would have to contest it with Kemintiri,
and an 11-cap would "steal" it from her.

cheers,

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo
